hints.title: Predecessor Condition
hints.text: A mountain at index i is stable only if the immediate predecessor mountain height[i-1] exceeds threshold.

hints.title: Boundary Enforcement
hints.text: Index 0 cannot have a predecessor and is never stable. Check indices starting strictly from 1 up to n - 1.

hints.title: Single Pass Collection
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to n - 1 and append index i to the result whenever height[i - 1] > threshold.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No alternative approach needed; linear check is already optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space excluding the returned output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean and bug-free linear loop with correct index offset handling.
